title: Black-Box Followers, White-Box Leaders: Partial Zeroth-Order Methods for MPECs
summary: We study mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints, in which a leader knows their own cost function, but lacks a model of the followers' response. Instead, the leader can only query this response at specific points. While this setting precludes the use of gradient-based methods, existing zeroth-order approaches treat the composed objective entirely as a black box, deploying zeroth-order tools across both the leader and follower.
